item.title: Identity and Security
item.description: Identity and security in Layer5 Cloud answer two questions for every request: who is acting, and what that person may do in the organization the request runs in. The answer is never decided by one thing. Organization membership, the roles a person holds in that organization, and resources shared with them directly each contribute, and the same person can hold different access in each organization they belong to. This page gives you that mental model and the boundaries it creates. To go straight to a task or a lookup, use Choose the right page.
